description: Cost Center this branch's sales/purchase transactions post to. Auto-filled on Sales/Purchase documents and locked for non-manager roles.
label: Cost Center
name: Branch-cost_center

description: SupplierCode from the legacy INVENTORY system (canonical/winning row after NTN merge).
label: Legacy Supplier Code
name: Supplier-custom_legacy_supplier_code

description: Default warehouse for this branch's sales and accepted purchase quantities. Auto-filled as Set Warehouse on Sales/Purchase documents.
label: Finished Goods Warehouse
name: Branch-finished_goods_warehouse

description: Default warehouse for rejected quantities on this branch's Purchase Receipts/Invoices.
label: Rejected Warehouse
name: Branch-rejected_warehouse

description: Branch this warehouse belongs to. Not auto-derived - set directly (backfilled from Branch.finished_goods_warehouse/rejected_warehouse) since a Branch may have more than these 2 warehouses in the future.
label: Branch
name: Warehouse-custom_branch

description: Branch-specific selling-only Price List, auto-created and populated when the Branch is initialized. Not hand-edited.
label: Default Selling Price List
name: Branch-default_selling_price_list

description: Logical terminal identifier for this POS Profile, shown read-only on the POS client. Multiple physical terminals may share the same value when they share this POS Profile.
label: Terminal ID
name: POS Profile-custom_terminal_id

label: FBR Status
name: POS Invoice-custom_fbr_status
options:
Not Sent
Sending
Accepted
Failed
Retry Required
Cancelled
Refunded

description: Auto-populated from the item's most recent submitted Purchase Receipt / Purchase Invoice line (price_after_taxes). Reference only, not user-editable.
label: Latest Price Incl Taxes
name: Item-custom_latest_price_incl_taxes

description: Unique ID assigned by the POS terminal. Used for idempotent submission.
label: Terminal Invoice ID
name: POS Invoice-custom_terminal_invoice_id

description: Posting date of the PR/PI that last set Latest Price Incl Taxes - used to avoid a backdated document overwriting a more recent price.
label: Latest Price Source Date
name: Item-custom_latest_price_source_date

description: Check to set an explicit loyalty points rate on this Item Group (including an explicit zero, to award no points here). Leave unchecked to inherit the rate from the nearest ancestor Item Group that has this checked.
label: Loyalty Rate Configured
name: Item Group-custom_loyalty_rate_configured

description: Hardware terminal identifier.
label: Terminal ID
name: POS Invoice-custom_terminal_id

description: Posting date of the Purchase Receipt that last set MRP via shelf_pricing - used to avoid a backdated document overwriting a more recent MRP, mirroring custom_latest_price_source_date.
label: MRP Source Date
name: Item-custom_mrp_source_date

description: Per-install, auto-generated UUID of the physical terminal that created this invoice. Distinct from custom_terminal_id (the shared/logical label from the POS Profile).
label: Hardware ID
name: POS Invoice-custom_hardware_id

description: Points earned per Rs 100 of a POS Invoice line's customer-facing (tax-inclusive) amount, for this Item Group and any descendant that does not itself override it.
label: Loyalty Points per Rs 100
name: Item Group-custom_loyalty_points_rate

description: Unique ID assigned by the POS terminal for a refund. Used for idempotent return submission.
label: Terminal Refund ID
name: POS Invoice-custom_terminal_refund_id

description: Cashier who rang up the sale, as verified by pos_cashier_login. May differ from the terminal's own API user.
label: Cashier
name: POS Invoice-custom_cashier_user

description: Cashier display name at time of sale, sent by the terminal.
label: Cashier Full Name
name: POS Invoice-custom_cashier_full_name

description: Set when the sale was rung up while the terminal was offline, using a cached cashier login.
label: Offline Authenticated
name: POS Invoice-custom_offline_authenticated

description: How the cashier was authenticated locally on the terminal (e.g. pin, password) when offline.
label: Offline Auth Method
name: POS Invoice-custom_offline_auth_method

description: Electron-generated identifier for the local offline cashier session that queued this sale.
label: Local Offline Session ID
name: POS Invoice-custom_local_offline_session_id

description: Latest known purchase cost including taxes for this item, for reference when setting the selling rate.
label: Latest Price Incl Taxes
name: Item Price-custom_latest_price_incl_taxes

description: Mirrors this user's default Branch (assigned via User Permission) - display only, not the source of truth.
label: Branch
name: User-custom_branch

description: Branch/Foodpanda-price-list-specific MRP, set by shelf_pricing alongside price_list_rate.
label: MRP
name: Item Price-custom_mrp

description: Snapshot of the previous submitted purchase cost after taxes for this item.
label: Old Cost Price After Taxes
name: Purchase Receipt Item-custom_old_price_after_tax

description: Whether this receipt's branch selling price/MRP update has been applied. Use the 'Update Branch Price' button to retry if left Pending.
label: Branch Price Update
name: Purchase Receipt-custom_branch_price_update_status

description: Whether this receipt's Foodpanda price update has been applied. Use the 'Update Foodpanda Price' button to retry if left Pending.
label: Foodpanda Price Update
name: Purchase Receipt-custom_foodpanda_price_update_status

description: Snapshot of the previous submitted purchase cost after taxes for this item.
label: Old Cost Price After Taxes
name: Purchase Order Item-custom_old_price_after_tax

description: Snapshot of the previous submitted purchase cost after taxes for this item.
label: Old Cost Price After Taxes
name: Purchase Invoice Item-custom_old_price_after_tax
